keys.summary: Multi-agent settings and custom subagent role declarations.
keys.detail: Scalar setting names in this table are reserved and cannot be used as custom role names.

keys.summary: Declaration of one custom subagent role.
keys.detail: Holds description, the role guidance Codex reads when choosing an agent type, and config_file. Sibling scalar keys such as enabled and default_subagent_model are reserved names.

keys.summary: Path to a TOML config layer applied when this role runs.
keys.detail: Relative paths resolve from the config file that declares the role.

keys.summary: Enable the multi-agent tools.
Allow shell tools to run commands in a login shell.
keys.detail: When false, login = true requests are rejected and an omitted login flag means a non-login shell.

keys.summary: Analytics settings for this machine or profile.
Send analytics from this machine or profile.
keys.detail: When unset, the client default applies.

keys.summary: When Codex pauses to ask for approval before acting.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this. It also accepts a granular table form. untrusted is unsupported and on-failure is deprecated.

keys.summary: Table form of approval_policy that allows or auto-rejects individual prompt categories.
keys.detail: Fields are sandbox_approval, rules, mcp_elicitations, request_permissions and skill_approval. Each is a boolean: true lets that prompt category surface, false auto-rejects it.

keys.summary: Who reviews eligible approval prompts.
keys.detail: auto_review hands the prompt to the reviewer subagent. It does not change sandboxing or widen what the sandbox already allows.

keys.summary: Settings for one app or connector, keyed by app id.
keys.detail: Same fields as apps._default, plus tools.<tool>.enabled and tools.<tool>.approval_mode for a single tool.

keys.summary: Enable or disable one app or connector.
Default settings applied to every app and connector.
keys.detail: Accepts enabled, default_tools_enabled, default_tools_approval_mode, approvals_reviewer, destructive_enabled and open_world_enabled. Any apps.<id> entry overrides these.

keys.summary: Automatic review settings.
Markdown policy instructions used for automatic review.
keys.detail: A managed guardian_policy_config takes precedence. Blank values are ignored.

keys.summary: Maximum poll window in milliseconds for empty background terminal reads.
keys.detail: Replaces the older background_terminal_timeout key.

keys.summary: Restrictions on agent-driven browser use.
keys.detail: default_origin_policy sets the fallback and browser_use.origins.<origin> overrides it per origin, each with access, uploads, downloads and full_cdp_access set to allow or deny.

keys.summary: Allow browser use to read browser history.
keys.detail: Managed requirements can force this off and local config cannot relax it.

keys.summary: Base URL used during the ChatGPT login flow.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this.

keys.summary: Check for Codex updates at startup.
keys.detail: Set false only when updates are managed centrally.

keys.summary: Where the CLI caches its credentials.
keys.detail: file uses $CODEX_HOME/auth.json, keyring uses the OS credential store, auto falls back to the file, and ephemeral keeps credentials in memory only.

keys.summary: Inline override for the history compaction prompt.
Fallback access policy for native apps under computer use.
keys.detail: Local configuration cannot relax managed restrictions.

keys.summary: Computer use app rules for macOS.
keys.detail: bundle_ids maps an exact macOS bundle identifier to allow or deny, replacing computer_use.default_app_access for that app.

keys.summary: Computer use app rules for Windows.
keys.detail: aumids covers packaged apps, exes covers signed unpackaged executables, and always_allowed_app_ids lists apps that skip prompting.

keys.summary: Name of the permission profile applied to sandboxed tool calls.
keys.detail: Built-ins are :read-only, :workspace and :danger-full-access. Custom names need a matching [permissions.<name>] table. Do not combine with sandbox_mode or [sandbox_workspace_write].

keys.summary: ChatGPT desktop app settings.
An extra Open in target for the desktop app.
keys.detail: User level only. command, label and icon are required. args, input, which is path, json_argument or json_stdin, and supports_ssh are optional.

keys.summary: Executable path or command name the handler launches.
Extra developer instructions injected into the session.
Disable burst-paste detection in the TUI.
Path to a file holding the compaction prompt override.
Feature flags for optional and in-development behavior.
keys.detail: Flags marked under development can change or disappear between releases. codex --enable <flag> sets one for a single run.

keys.summary: Turn one named feature flag on or off.
keys.detail: Use the canonical flag names from the configuration reference. Unknown names are ignored.

keys.summary: Use notes and searchable history instead of repeated summary compression.
keys.detail: Requires ChatGPT sign-in on Plus, Pro or Pro Lite.

keys.summary: Enable lifecycle hooks from hooks.json or inline [hooks].
keys.detail: features.codex_hooks is a deprecated alias.

keys.summary: Enable the Memories feature.
Enable the multi-agent tools spawn_agent, send_input, resume_agent, wait_agent and close_agent.
Start the network proxy that enforces domain rules for sandboxed commands.
keys.detail: Off by default. Without it, permission profile domain rules are not enforced and command network access is direct. Accepts a table when you need to set proxy options. Does not filter web search, apps or MCP traffic.

keys.summary: Domain policy for sandboxed command networking, keyed by host pattern with allow or deny.
keys.detail: Unset means nothing outbound is allowed. Supports *.example.com, **.example.com and a global *. Deny wins on conflict.

keys.summary: Deprecated toggle for the web search tool.
keys.detail: Use the top-level web_search setting instead. When web_search is unset, features.web_search_cached maps to cached and features.web_search_request maps to live.

keys.summary: Feedback submission settings.
Allow feedback submission through /feedback.
URI scheme used to open file citations from Codex output.
Limit ChatGPT logins to one workspace id.
Restrict Codex to one authentication method.
Suppress reasoning events in the TUI and in codex exec output.
Session transcript history settings.
Cap on the history file size in bytes, dropping oldest entries.
Whether session transcripts are written to history.jsonl.
keys.detail: Set none to stop writing local transcripts. It does not delete an existing history.jsonl.

keys.summary: Lifecycle hooks declared inline in config.toml.
keys.detail: Hooks can live in config.toml or in a hooks.json next to it. If one layer has both, Codex loads both and warns. Requires features.hooks.

keys.summary: Matcher groups for one hook event.
keys.detail: Events include PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, UserPromptSubmit, Stop and Interrupt.

keys.summary: Handlers run for one matcher group.
keys.detail: Command and MCP tool handlers run. Prompt and agent handlers are parsed and skipped.

keys.summary: Token threshold above which oversized hook context is written to disk and previewed.
keys.detail: Set 0 to pass the full context straight to the model.

keys.summary: Run a command handler in the background instead of blocking the triggering operation.
keys.detail: SessionEnd always runs synchronously regardless of this setting.

keys.summary: Reserved for future use.
keys.detail: Codex does not read this today. Use model_instructions_file or AGENTS.md instead.

keys.summary: Directory Codex writes log files to.
keys.detail: Defaults to $CODEX_HOME/log. Setting it explicitly also enables the plaintext TUI log codex-tui.log there.

keys.summary: Git repository URL or local directory for a plugin marketplace.
keys.detail: A local source must be an absolute path containing .agents/plugins/marketplace.json. A git source also accepts ref and sparse_paths.

keys.summary: Kind of marketplace source.
Base callback URL for MCP OAuth login, such as a devbox ingress URL.
Where MCP OAuth credentials are stored.
Definition of one MCP server, keyed by the name Codex shows for its tools.
keys.detail: Set command for a stdio server or url for a streamable HTTP server, not both. startup_timeout_sec defaults to 10 and tool_timeout_sec to 60.

keys.summary: Arguments passed to the stdio MCP server command.
Authentication fallback used after configured tokens and headers.
keys.detail: chatgpt reuses the current ChatGPT session for the trusted first-party origin, then falls back to stored OAuth credentials.

keys.summary: Launcher command for a stdio MCP server.
Turn one MCP server off without deleting its configuration.
Allow list of tool names exposed by the server.
keys.detail: disabled_tools is applied after this list.

keys.summary: Environment variables forwarded to the stdio MCP server.
keys.detail: Values are stored in plain text in config.toml, so prefer bearer_token_env_var or env_vars for secrets.

keys.summary: OAuth client settings for one MCP server.
keys.detail: Holds client_id for a pre-registered client, plus callback_url and callback_port, which override mcp_oauth_callback_url and mcp_oauth_callback_port for this server.

keys.summary: Per-tool overrides for one tool on this MCP server.
Approval behavior for one MCP tool.
Endpoint for a streamable HTTP MCP server.
Settings for the Memories feature.
keys.detail: Requires features.memories, which is off by default. Generated memories are written to ~/.codex/memories/. Extra keys tune extraction models, thread age and rate limit thresholds.

keys.summary: Store new threads as inputs for memory generation.
Inject existing memories into new sessions.
Model slug used for new turns, for example gpt-5.5.
Token threshold that triggers automatic history compaction.
keys.detail: When unset, the model default applies.

keys.summary: Whether the auto-compaction threshold counts the whole context or only growth after the prefix.
Path to a JSON model catalog loaded at startup.
keys.detail: A selected profile file can override the catalog per profile.

keys.summary: Context window tokens available to the active model.
keys.detail: Only needed when Codex does not know the window for a custom or self-hosted model.

keys.summary: Path to a file that replaces the built-in instructions.
keys.detail: Relative paths in a project config resolve against the .codex/ folder holding that config.

keys.summary: Provider id from model_providers to send requests to.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this. Built-in ids are openai, ollama and lmstudio; anything else must have a matching [model_providers.<id>] table.

keys.summary: Definition of a custom model provider.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this. The built-in ids openai, ollama and lmstudio are reserved. wire_api defaults to responses, the only supported protocol.

keys.summary: Command-backed bearer token configuration for the provider.
keys.detail: Do not combine with env_key, experimental_bearer_token or requires_openai_auth.

keys.summary: Command Codex runs to mint a bearer token. It must print the token to stdout.
API base URL for the provider.
Name of the environment variable holding the provider API key.
Bearer token written directly into the config file.
keys.detail: This stores a credential in plain text. Prefer env_key or the auth command.

keys.summary: Display name for the provider.
OAuth settings for a custom model provider.
keys.detail: The configuration reference documents env_key and the auth command instead. Treat this table as undocumented and verify against your Codex version before relying on it.

keys.summary: Reasoning effort for models that support it.
keys.detail: Responses API only. xhigh is model dependent and is ignored by models that do not advertise it.

keys.summary: Level of detail for reasoning summaries, or none to disable them.
Force Codex to send or skip reasoning metadata for the active model.
keys.detail: Set this only when a custom provider mishandles reasoning fields that Codex would otherwise send.

keys.summary: Response verbosity override for the GPT-5 Responses API.
keys.detail: When unset the selected model or preset default applies.

keys.summary: Acknowledgement state for one-time warnings and prompts.
keys.detail: Written by Codex when you dismiss a prompt. It lives in config.toml but is not a user setting. Entries cover access warnings, model migration prompts and rate limit nudges.

keys.summary: Records that the full access warning has been acknowledged.
External command invoked for notifications, given a JSON payload.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this. The array is the program and its leading arguments; Codex appends the JSON event.

keys.summary: Base URL override for the built-in openai provider.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this. Use it for an LLM proxy, router or data residency project instead of defining a new provider.

keys.summary: Local provider used when running with --oss.
keys.detail: When unset, Codex prompts for a provider.

keys.summary: OpenTelemetry export settings.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set anything in this table. environment tags emitted events and defaults to dev.

keys.summary: Exporter used for OpenTelemetry logs.
Endpoint settings for the selected log exporter, keyed by exporter name.
keys.detail: Holds endpoint, headers, protocol and a tls table with ca-certificate, client-certificate and client-private-key paths.

keys.summary: Include raw user prompts in exported OpenTelemetry logs.
keys.detail: Off by default. Turning it on sends prompt text to your collector.

keys.summary: Exporter used for OpenTelemetry metrics.
keys.detail: Set none to stop metrics leaving the machine.

keys.summary: Exporter used for OpenTelemetry traces.
Endpoint settings for the selected trace exporter.
keys.detail: Same shape as otel.exporter.<id>: endpoint, headers, protocol and a tls table.

keys.summary: A named, reusable permission profile.
keys.detail: Profiles are selected with default_permissions or per session. Unlike flat allow and deny lists, a profile bundles description, extends, filesystem, network and workspace root rules under one name.

keys.summary: Parent profile applied before this one.
keys.detail: Accepts another profile name, :read-only or :workspace. :danger-full-access, unknown parents and cycles are rejected.

keys.summary: Filesystem rules for the profile, keyed by absolute path, glob or special token.
keys.detail: Special tokens include :minimal and :workspace_roots.

keys.summary: Access granted for one path or glob inside the profile.
keys.detail: A table value instead of a string scopes nested entries under that root.

keys.summary: Network rules for commands run under the profile.
keys.detail: mode selects limited or full proxy behavior, and proxy_url, socks_url and the dangerously_ prefixed keys tune the listener.

keys.summary: Allow or deny one host or wildcard pattern for sandboxed commands.
keys.detail: Supports exact hosts, *.example.com for subdomains, **.example.com for apex plus subdomains, and a global *. Deny wins on conflict. Does not restrict web search, apps or MCP servers.

keys.summary: Allow network access for commands in this profile.
keys.detail: This does not start the proxy. Without features.network_proxy or managed network requirements, command traffic is direct and the profile domain rules are not enforced.

keys.summary: Extra workspace roots that receive the profile's :workspace_roots filesystem rules.
keys.detail: Each key is a path and each value is a boolean that opts that path into the root set.

keys.summary: Default communication style for models that advertise personality support.
keys.detail: Can be overridden per thread with /personality. Requires features.personality.

keys.summary: Reasoning effort used while Plan mode is active.
keys.detail: When unset, Plan mode uses its built-in preset instead of model_reasoning_effort.

keys.summary: Settings for one installed plugin, keyed as plugin-name@marketplace-name.
keys.detail: Besides enabled, it can carry mcp_servers.<server> entries that enable, filter or set approval modes for servers the plugin bundles.

keys.summary: Enable or disable one installed plugin.
keys.detail: Read from the merged config, so a trusted project can override user, cloud-managed and system defaults. It does not override workspace-managed states.

keys.summary: Additional filenames to try when AGENTS.md is missing.
Maximum bytes read from AGENTS.md when building project instructions.
Filenames that mark a project root when searching parent directories.
Per-project record keyed by absolute path or worktree path.
keys.detail: Codex appends one table here for every directory you approve, so this section grows large on an active machine.

keys.summary: Whether a project or worktree is trusted.
keys.detail: Written automatically when you answer the trust prompt. Untrusted projects skip all project-scoped .codex/ layers, including config, hooks and rules.

keys.summary: Model used by the /review command.
keys.detail: Defaults to the current session model.

keys.summary: Sandbox policy for filesystem and network access during command execution.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set this. It is the older surface; default_permissions with named profiles is the newer one, and the two should not be combined.

keys.summary: Settings that apply when sandbox_mode is workspace-write.
keys.detail: Project config cannot set any key in this table.

keys.summary: Remove /tmp from the writable roots.
Remove the directory named by $TMPDIR from the writable roots.
Allow outbound network access inside the workspace-write sandbox.
Additional directories the sandbox may write to.
Preferred service tier for new turns.
keys.detail: Use fast, which maps to the request value priority, or another tier advertised by the active model.

keys.summary: Which environment variables are passed to processes Codex spawns.
keys.detail: set injects explicit values after exclusions run, so never put secrets there. experimental_use_profile sources the user shell profile.

keys.summary: Case-insensitive variable name patterns mapped to include or exclude.
keys.detail: Include entries create an allowlist and cannot restore excluded values. Do not combine with the legacy include_only and exclude arrays in the same layer.

keys.summary: Keep variables whose names contain KEY, SECRET or TOKEN.
keys.detail: Defaults to true, meaning secret-looking variables are passed through. Set false to apply the automatic exclusions.

keys.summary: Baseline environment inherited by spawned processes.
keys.detail: core keeps a minimal set such as HOME, PATH and USER.

keys.summary: Show raw reasoning content when the active model emits it.
Per-skill enablement overrides.
keys.detail: Each entry is a table with path, pointing at a folder containing SKILL.md, and enabled.

keys.summary: Token budget for the available-skills catalog.
keys.detail: Defaults to 2 percent of the model context window. Explicit values are capped at 10000 tokens.

keys.summary: Directory holding the SQLite state database used by agent jobs and resumable runs.
Hide the warning shown when under-development feature flags are enabled.
Token budget for storing an individual tool or function output in history.
Connectors or plugins that must never be suggested.
keys.detail: Same entry shape as tool_suggest.discoverables.

keys.summary: Connectors or plugins that may be suggested as tools.
keys.detail: Each entry sets type, either connector or plugin, and an id.

keys.summary: Built-in tool configuration.
Enable the view_image tool for attaching local images.
Enable and configure the web search tool.
keys.detail: Accepts a table with context_size, allowed_domains and an approximate location. These domain filters are separate from sandbox network rules and do not restrict connectors or MCP servers.

keys.summary: Terminal UI options.
keys.detail: Also holds show_tooltips, raw_output_mode, resume_cwd, terminal_title and notification_method beyond the keys listed here.

keys.summary: Whether the TUI uses the terminal alternate screen.
keys.detail: auto skips the alternate screen in Zellij so scrollback is preserved.

keys.summary: Enable terminal animations such as the welcome screen, shimmer and spinner.
Key binding for one TUI action in one context.
keys.detail: Contexts include global, chat, composer, editor, vim_normal, vim_operator, vim_text_object, pager, list and approval. An array binds several keys, and an empty array unbinds the action.

keys.summary: Internal startup tooltip counter keyed by model slug.
keys.detail: Written by Codex. It lives in config.toml but is not a user setting.

keys.summary: Enable terminal notifications, optionally as an array restricting them to specific event types.
Ordered list of footer status line item ids, or null to hide the status line.
keys.detail: terminal_title takes the same kind of list for the window or tab title and defaults to ["spinner", "project"].

keys.summary: Syntax highlighting theme, given as a kebab-case theme name.
Start the composer in Vim normal mode.
keys.detail: Can still be toggled per session with /vim.

keys.summary: Web search mode.
keys.detail: cached uses an OpenAI-maintained index with no external access, indexed allows external access only through the index, and live allows unrestricted retrieval. Full access sandbox modes default to live.

keys.summary: Native Windows sandbox mode.
Run the sandboxed child process on a private Windows desktop.
keys.detail: Set false only for compatibility with the older Winsta0\Default behavior.

keys.summary: Records that the Windows WSL onboarding prompt was acknowledged.

paths.summary: Primary user configuration in TOML. Every key in this pack lives here unless noted otherwise.
Profile override loaded with --profile <profile>. Uses top-level keys, not a nested table.
Lifecycle hooks in JSON, an alternative to an inline [hooks] table in config.toml.
Global agent instructions applied in every project.
User rule files that constrain which commands Codex may run.
Personal skills, one directory per skill with a SKILL.md entrypoint.
Skills bundled with Codex. Managed by the installer, not meant to be edited.
Installed plugins from configured marketplaces.
Download cache for plugin marketplaces.
Memories written by Codex when the Memories feature is on.
Skills imported from other vendors. Refreshed by Codex, not hand edited.
Cached login credentials when cli_auth_credentials_store is file or auto. Never read or copy this file.
Recorded session rollouts.
Codex log files, including codex-tui.log when log_dir is set.
SQLite state database directory used by agent jobs.
Captured shell environments used to speed up repeated commands.
General on-disk cache.
Scratch directory for in-flight work.
Hidden scratch directory for in-flight work.
Session transcript log written when history.persistence is save-all.
Index of recorded sessions used for resume.
Cached model catalog fetched at startup.
SQLite databases and their journals, such as logs_2.sqlite and state_5.sqlite.
Generated identifier for this installation.
Records the installed Codex version.
Global runtime state written by Codex.
Marker for the one-time personality migration.
Project-scoped config, loaded only in trusted projects and only for keys the project layer may set.
Project-scoped lifecycle hooks, loaded only in trusted projects.
Project-scoped rule files, loaded only in trusted projects.
Project instructions read from the repository root.
